differentiators.claim: Elements carry state in their bodies: white and quiet at rest, igniting in their own spectrum color on touch; orbs breathe and orbit; cards lift and warm.
differentiators.mechanism: Motion is a truth claim: never animate intelligence that did not happen, never hide intelligence that did.
differentiators.title: Living intelligence — state you can see, not read

differentiators.claim: Form is a language: diamond = intelligence, circle = state, square = destination; one soul color per board; every color has one job; jewels carry trust tiers.
evidence: NAYA-JWL-020 Meaning spheres: Priority, Presence, Understanding, Verified, Value
NAYA-ORB-006–008 Truth orbs: Verified, Demonstration, Claim
NAYA-JWL-001–005 gem bullets, 'drawn jewel, not a dot', five spectrum colors
differentiators.mechanism: Spectrum law (SPEC.ai.md) + color jobs (Design Code §2: purple #9d75ff signature/glow-never-fill, blue knowledge, teal connection, emerald alive/true, lime learning, gold value, red alarm-only, magenta human significance).
differentiators.title: Meaning encoded in form — shape grammar, spectrum law, meaning jewels

differentiators.claim: Surfaces are cut objects with inner light, not flat rectangles: faceted jewels, white-hot cores, layered elevation.
evidence: design-contract v2: .jewel (faceted radial core + inset light/shade + glow), .report-board (luminous top beam), .sp-card (6px lift, own-color ignition)
differentiators.mechanism: Depth equation (SPEC.ai.md): 145deg gradient surface, 1px border #ffffff18, radius 17, inset top highlight, grounding drop shadow, accent glow; elevation scale field > boards > boards-in-boards > controls > overlays (Design Code §6). First check: the top highlight.
differentiators.title: Depth as physics — the depth equation

differentiators.claim: Every surface is authored once for the system's three players: Human in front, AI behind the view switch, Machine behind the item door.
evidence: Hub SPEC trio: SPEC.human.md / SPEC.ai.md / spec.machine.json
differentiators.mechanism: Standing three-language standard applied per entry; the view switch is an existing shelf piece, never rebuilt.
differentiators.title: Three tongues by design — Human / AI / Machine

differentiators.claim: Numbers are computed from the record at read time, never typed; unmeasured renders DARK with the reason on its face; counts are never dressed as rows; demo is labeled demo.
evidence: Naya-Design-Code-V1.md §11 (truth in states), §12 forbidden list item 8 (fake liveness)
differentiators.mechanism: Runtime honesty states (SPEC.ai.md): loading, ready, empty, not_verified, blocked, error; truth-in-states law (Design Code §11).
differentiators.title: Honesty built into the surface — the interface cannot lie

differentiators.claim: Every figure opens its own list; every room/page card is a door with an Open control, a preview line, and a link into the real page. The face is the system working, not a picture of it.
evidence: PI face acceptance law (director scorecard round 1 and 2, MEMORY.md)
differentiators.mechanism: Matrix law: movement next page, next system, down, up, and in, always oriented; zero screenshot-dead-ends.
differentiators.title: Every number a door — no dead ends

differentiators.claim: Every piece carries a code and a name in one shelf, so any builder (human or Naya) can name, find, and reuse it verbatim; consistency is structural at any scale.
evidence: Smart Factory live inventory 2026-10-26: 152 coded pieces (BTN 33, ICO 23, ORB 8, JWL 21, BRD 30, ROW 4, INP 7, HDR 3, MRK 7, NAV 11, OVL 5)
differentiators.mechanism: Law 14: compose from the library verbatim; genuinely new components join window.NayaUI instead of being hand-rolled inline.
differentiators.title: One library, one language — compose, never reinvent

differentiators.claim: Internal rigor (provenance, verification, computed truth) never leaks across the glass; the person's side opens with essence, then meaning, then use, then payoff.
evidence: Smart Note four-layer presentation on live Hub cards (In a Nutshell / What It Means / How It Applies / What's In It For You)
differentiators.mechanism: Intelligent Block presentation contract: nutshell > what it means > how to use it > what's in it for you (Design Code §8); canon: Internal Rigor / External Simplicity.
differentiators.title: Rigorous inside, push-button simple outside

differentiators.claim: The face binds to the live record (rows, not counts), movement is visible on it, and notes attach to anything in it. No second maintained copy drifts from the truth.
evidence: PI setup law: GitHub home, App sync, Hub display, provenance on every landing
HUB/PROJECT-INTELLIGENCE-BUILD-INTELLIGENCE data contract (single source, rows, computed, freshness per section)
differentiators.mechanism: One record, one canonical source; every other reader is a measured projection; state changes generate the pulse; a quiet face on a working day is a broken face.
differentiators.title: The record and the face are one

directive.statement: The design playbook is for all Nayas to become masters of Naya design: understand the language, how we are different, why we are innovative, why our interfaces are 10x better. Extraordinary today, bullseye not yet hit; the striving is forever.

honest_gaps.gap: Hub Smart Feed still uses flat text/emoji controls (LOVE/LIKE/FAVORITE/star) instead of jewel pieces.
Plain status dots survive in live pieces, including the Factory's own BRD-036 data-table sample (Active/Pending/Paused dots).
Live Projects, Growth, and Today pages carry thin-outline circular icon rows with no labels and no codes — not from the shelf.
BRD-033 stat-grid rendering missing from the repo working store (27 BRD entries in pieces.json vs 30 live); store holds 155 keys vs 152 live pieces — store/live drift, unadjudicated.
Hub home hand-rolls 18 one-off inline SVGs; no sprite or reusable icon system on the approved front door.
Grandfathered amber/rose orbital jewels on the live entrance await recolor under the spectrum law.
Hub SPEC trio not yet in repo HUB/app/; canonical home is still a local working copy (~/workspace/hub-app-build/HUB/app/).

loop.delivery_rule: Only complete 9+ pages go to Shawn, each with its scorecard; everything below the bar stays team-internal.
loop.name: the forever loop
loop.statement: Mastery is a loop, never a state: build from the library, cold-score, rip apart what is below the bar, level up, re-score — forever.
steps: study: live surface first at phone width, then the shelf inventory; name the data truth before layout
build: compose verbatim from the library; depth equation; spectrum law; glyph-in-jewel; computed numbers only; three tongues; honest states; mobile-first
prove: SPEC self-scorecard, then D1-D8 with per-dimension evidence, then the page's own instrument where one exists, then different-seat cold check at the exact commit
level_up: fix across seats; the starter need not be the finisher, but it must be finished
close: Project Intelligence entry updated the same pass with the scorecard receipt

thresholds.9_0_to_9_49: director-review eligible only with every dimension >= 9.0
thresholds.critical_failure_rule: a critical security, privacy, or broken-core-flow failure can never be averaged away

playbook.note: Skill name predates the team widening; content is team doctrine for every seat.
playbook.skill_section: Why Naya interfaces are different — the team doctrine

repo_placement.route: draft PR via Git Data API; never merged by the authoring seat

procedure: Name in one sentence: what the page is, what matters most on it, what to do next.
If any of the three needs explanation, the page goes back — no scorecard average rescues it.
seconds_test.statement: The interface IS the user experience. A cold person opens the page and understands what is going on within seconds, unaided, or the job is not done.

tongues.rule: same truth, three tongues; authored once, never translated as an afterthought
